scenario: the first practical exchange about repairs & home services
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Repairs and Home Services
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: repairs & home services — the first practical exchange about repairs & home services
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about repairs & home services; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan reports a broken door lock to Ms Olivia.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan báo với chị Olivia khóa cửa nhà mình bị hỏng.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Olivia. My door lock is broken.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Olivia. Khóa cửa nhà tôi bị hỏng rồi.

turns.speaker: Ms Olivia
turns.english: I see. I will send someone right away.
turns.vietnamese: Tôi hiểu rồi. Tôi cử người đến ngay đây.
